# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — ObfuscateGuard

```html
<h2>ObfuscateGuard — Obfuscation Orchestration for Java/Kotlin</h2>

<p>
  ObfuscateGuard is a workflow, analysis, and governance layer for Java/Kotlin obfuscation.
  It works on top of ProGuard/R8, yGuard, and Allatori — helping you set up, validate, and
  manage obfuscation directly inside your IDE.
</p>

<h3>Setup and Configuration</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Configuration Wizard</b> — Guided setup with auto-detection of build system and project type</li>
  <li><b>ProGuard Syntax Highlighting</b> — Full editor support for .pro configuration files</li>
  <li><b>Run Configuration</b> — Execute obfuscation with real-time log streaming and progress tracking</li>
</ul>

<h3>Risk Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Safe-Mode Analyzer</b> — Detect reflection, serialization, JNI, and DI risks before obfuscation</li>
  <li><b>Inline Inspections</b> — Risk warnings directly in the editor with one-click quick fixes</li>
  <li><b>Gutter Icons</b> — Visual markers on risky lines (Class.forName, native methods, DI annotations)</li>
  <li><b>Dry-Run Validation</b> — Simulate obfuscation to get a pass/fail verdict without running it</li>
</ul>

<h3>Mapping and Debugging</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Stack Trace Deobfuscator</b> — Paste obfuscated crash logs, get original class and method names</li>
  <li><b>Mapping Vault</b> — Encrypted storage with diff viewer and export for crash symbolication</li>
  <li><b>Keep Rules Generator</b> — Automatic keep rules with traceability and review workflow</li>
</ul>

<h3>Team and CI/CD</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>CI/CD Export</b> — Generate pipeline templates for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins</li>
  <li><b>Policy Engine</b> — Team-wide obfuscation rules and enforcement (Business tier)</li>
  <li><b>Audit Trail</b> — Full logging of all obfuscation actions (Business tier)</li>
  <li><b>Shared Profiles</b> — VCS-based team configuration sharing (Business tier)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free</b> — Configuration wizard, project detection, run configuration, tool window, ProGuard highlighting</li>
  <li><b>Pro</b> — Risk analysis, inline inspections, dry-run validation, deobfuscator, mapping vault, CI/CD export</li>
  <li><b>Business</b> — Policy engine, audit trail, shared profiles</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ or compatible JetBrains IDE</li>
  <li>Java or Kotlin project with Gradle or Maven</li>
</ul>
```
